Provides a resource to create a DLC standard engine resource group

> **NOTE:** If you are creating a machine learning resource group for the first time, you need to contact DLC product for whitelisting.

> **NOTE:** Field `autoPauseTime` is meaningful only when the values ​​of fields `autoLaunch` and `autoPause` are 0.

> **NOTE:** If you need to set the `staticConfigPairs` or `dynamicConfigPairs`, it is recommended to use resource `tencentcloud.Dlc.StandardEngineResourceGroupConfigInfo`.
